headline: Osia Hyper Retail Limited: 3rd CoC Meeting held in CIRP
sum: Osia Hyper Retail Limited's 3rd Committee of Creditors meeting was rescheduled from 22 June to 25 June 2026 and held via hybrid mode, continuing its corporate insolvency resolution process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
detail: Osia Hyper Retail Limited, a retail entity, is undergoing CIRP. The third meeting of its Committee of Creditors was originally scheduled for 22 June 2026 at 16:30 IST but was rescheduled to 25 June 2026 at 14:30 IST and conducted in hybrid mode (video conference and physical attendance). The NSE filing confirms the meeting occurrence and reschedule, as mandated under IBC disclosure rules for listed entities.
